steps_to_reproduce: Open any major route in desktop or mobile local demo.
expected_result: Primary workflow should be visible with optional help unobtrusive or user-invoked.
actual_result: Brad onboarding panel auto-opens over every major route; on mobile it blocks most of the viewport and hides primary actions/content.
recommended_fix: Gate Brad onboarding behind explicit launcher or one-time dismissed state for production demo; never cover critical workflow controls by default.

surface: Evidence Center trust and artifact defensibility
steps_to_reproduce: Open Evidence Center and switch to File ledger.
expected_result: Evidence demo should show at least one complete viewable evidence artifact with clear event/task/form/policy traceability.
actual_result: Evidence Center shows 244 events, 5114 tasks, 10716 requirements, 0% audit-ready, 0 locked evidence; default file ledger shows no evidence uploaded and upload blocked.
recommended_fix: Seed a complete demo evidence chain with viewable artifact/PDF and make empty states clearly non-production or selected-context-specific.

surface: Internal QA overlays and sandbox labels
steps_to_reproduce: Open Calendar, dismiss Brad, click Monthly OIG/SAM Exclusion Check.
expected_result: Production demo event drawer should present compliance status, actions, and evidence without QA/test language.
actual_result: Drawer shows Guided UAT overlay plus SANDBOX / TRAINING PLAYGROUND, RESET SANDBOX, and RESET ALL Q1/Q2 controls in compliance workflow.
recommended_fix: Hide QA reset controls and training labels outside explicit QA mode; keep demo-specific copy minimal and functional.

surface: Audit Mode density and encoding polish
steps_to_reproduce: Open Audit Mode and select Annual Governance Packet Review.
expected_result: Survey readiness view should be clean, readable, and free of encoding artifacts.
actual_result: View is dense with chips/cards/status containers; selected details compete with overlays; captured text includes mojibake characters such as Â· and â†’.
recommended_fix: Reduce visible chip/card noise, prioritize selected evidence state, remove overlay competition, and fix text encoding in audit labels.

surface: ACHC Survey Alignment cramped dark-mode grid
steps_to_reproduce: Open ACHC Survey Alignment in dark mode.
expected_result: Surveyor evidence explorer should have strong hierarchy, readable filters, and clear action affordances.
actual_result: Rows are cramped with pale bands, many badges, dashed separators, low-contrast filters, and overlay content covering the right side.
recommended_fix: Rework ACHC into cleaner two-panel evidence/detail layout, improve dark contrast, and remove overlay obstruction.

steps_to_reproduce: Open Calendar or Evidence on 390px mobile viewport.
expected_result: Mobile should expose navigation, filters, and task/evidence actions without modal obstruction.
actual_result: Brad panel consumes most of the viewport; route content, tabs, filters, and actions are hidden behind it.
recommended_fix: Use bottom-sheet guidance only after explicit user action or provide a compact dismissible banner on mobile.

surface: Forms and Policy Detail mixed visual language
steps_to_reproduce: Open Forms Library, open Universal Policy Acknowledgment Form, open Policy GV-EA-001.
expected_result: Forms and policy content should share the V3 production visual system and preserve readability.
actual_result: Forms use many boxed chips/cards; form viewer switches to bright paper mode inside dark shell; policy detail is very dark and has competing TOC/metadata/checklist regions.
recommended_fix: Unify dark/light treatment for app controls vs printable document, simplify tags, and reduce competing side overlays.

steps_to_reproduce: Run style sweep on major shell routes.
expected_result: V3 surfaces should avoid transform hover effects and redundant card-like boxes.
actual_result: Computed style sweep detected transform matrices on persistent shell controls and very high card-like counts on Dashboard/Forms.
recommended_fix: Audit shell controls for transform-based effects and reduce unnecessary bordered/background containers.
